rules.name: One pass, not two
rules.blurb: Quickmini trims and compresses in a single ffmpeg pass — cut footage is never decoded, which took a typical export from 25 seconds to under 6.

rules.name: Correct first, fast second
rules.blurb: A stream-copy trim was 20× faster but could only cut on keyframes, and a 7-second trim once exported 18.8 seconds. It was removed.

rules.name: Keep the lab notes
rules.blurb: Approaches that failed — a multithreaded ffmpeg core that deadlocks, a codec that crashes the wasm heap — are recorded in the source next to the code they shaped.

rules.name: Test the deployed thing
rules.blurb: An export once broke while the page looked fine, so changes are verified against the live site, not just a local preview.
